This petition is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 6 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in S.C.No.796/2022 on the file of XLV Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru (CCH-46) arising out of Crime No.608/2018 registered by Rajagopala Nagar Police Station, Bengaluru and charge sheeted offence punishable under Section 498A and 307 read with Section 34 of IPC.

sentences.text: Both of them have settled their issues before the matrimonial Court in M.C.No.4914/2018.

4. Respondent No.2 not present before the Court, in view of the matter already settled between the parties, learned NC: 2024:KHC:6782 counsel for Respondent No.2 not objected to quash the criminal proceedings.

5. Considering the same, in view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and Another reported in 2012 CRI.L.J.4934 wherein, it has been held that in cases where the parties have settled the dispute between them in respect of a matrimonial case,
the Court can quash the proceedings.
